Name: Cathulhu
Author: Nahogani
Description:
This mod replaces the base cat sprite with the adorable elder god, Cathulhu. This mod also adds the Cathulhu head to the character creation page.

Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/30465775]DarkSylux315[/url] your Cathulhu can now make the wondrous noises of an Elder God. You can find their mod[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2140] here[/url]!

Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51550156]PurpleManiac04[/url] for requesting this wonderful enhancement for Cathulhu.

[code][size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][/code]
